governance.access: A constructed entrance, driveway, route, road frontage or proximity link is not proof of a legal right of way, easement, emergency access right or ownership.
governance.boundary: Planning parcel geometry is retained as source evidence only. It is not a legal survey, registered title plan or proof of exact legal boundary.
governance.contractual: Lease, licence and concession rows are references to existing tenure agreements. No duplicate contract or new legal grant is created.
governance.population_and_finance: No person, population, invoice, payment, loan balance or financial posting is created.
governance.unknowns: No missing easement, covenant, charge, lien or boundary agreement is represented as absent. Such rights remain unverified until evidence is recorded.
governance.utilities: A recorded utility connection does not establish a wayleave, easement, landowner consent or asset ownership right.
